package.author: Shivam Khetan
package.description: A local-first Markdown and MDX knowledge workspace.

en-US.author: Shivam Khetan
en-US.description: A local-first Markdown and MDX knowledge workspace.
en-US.longDescription: Neuron keeps your notes as plain Markdown files on your own disk, with databases, canvases and sandboxed HTML views on top. No account, no telemetry.
en-US.name: Neuron
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- Trigger package publishing from the release run, not the release by @shiv-khetan in #29
- Package-manager trigger fix by @shiv-khetan in #30
- WinGet needs a manual first submission, and pin the action by @shiv-khetan in #31
- WinGet first-submission docs and action pin by @shiv-khetan in #32
- Take generated output and agent material out of the app repo by @shiv-khetan in #33
- The website moves out, and docs/ stops being published by @shiv-khetan in #34
- Site moves out; repo slimming by @shiv-khetan in #35
- Redirect stubs follow the site into light only by @shiv-khetan in #36
- Light-only redirect stubs by @shiv-khetan in #37
- docs: bring contributor docs and install channels to main by @shiv-khetan in #67
- release: 0.5.0 by @shiv-khetan in #80
Full Changelog: v0.4.5...v0.5.0
